title: How to Get a Mexican Passport
description: Complete step-by-step guide to obtaining or renewing your Mexican passport. Includes required documents, costs, and office locations.
descriptionEs: Guia completa paso a paso para obtener o renovar tu pasaporte mexicano. Incluye documentos requeridos, costos y ubicaciones de oficinas.

steps.title: Schedule an Appointment
steps.description: Visit the SRE (Secretaria de Relaciones Exteriores) website to schedule your appointment online. Appointments are required - walk-ins are not accepted.
steps.descriptionEs: Visita el sitio web de la SRE (Secretaria de Relaciones Exteriores) para agendar tu cita en linea. Las citas son obligatorias - no se aceptan sin cita.
steps.tips: Schedule at least 2-3 weeks in advance. Morning appointments tend to have shorter wait times.

steps.title: Gather Required Documents
steps.description: Prepare all necessary documents before your appointment. Original documents are required - no copies.
steps.descriptionEs: Prepara todos los documentos necesarios antes de tu cita. Se requieren documentos originales - no copias.
documents: Birth certificate (certified copy, not older than 5 years)
Official photo ID (INE, military ID, or professional license)
steps.tips: If your birth certificate is older than 5 years, you can get a new certified copy at the Registro Civil.

steps.title: Pay the Fee
steps.description: Pay the passport fee at any authorized bank or online. Keep your payment receipt - you'll need it at your appointment.
steps.descriptionEs: Paga la tarifa del pasaporte en cualquier banco autorizado o en linea. Guarda tu recibo de pago - lo necesitaras en tu cita.
steps.tips: As of 2026: 1-year passport ~$700 MXN, 3-year ~$1,200 MXN, 6-year ~$1,800 MXN, 10-year ~$2,500 MXN. Prices may vary.

steps.title: Attend Your Appointment
steps.description: Arrive at the SRE office 15 minutes early. Bring all original documents and your payment receipt. You will be photographed and fingerprinted at the office.
steps.descriptionEs: Llega a la oficina de la SRE 15 minutos antes. Lleva todos los documentos originales y tu recibo de pago. Te tomaran foto y huellas digitales en la oficina.
steps.tips: Wear a plain, light-colored shirt for your photo. No glasses, hats, or earrings.

steps.title: Receive Your Passport
steps.description: Your passport will be ready for pickup in approximately 3-5 business days. Bring your appointment receipt and an official ID to collect it.
steps.descriptionEs: Tu pasaporte estara listo para recoger en aproximadamente 3-5 dias habiles. Lleva tu recibo de cita y una identificacion oficial para recogerlo.

title: How to Get Your INE Voter ID
description: The INE (Instituto Nacional Electoral) voter ID is Mexico's most widely accepted form of identification. Here's how to get yours.
descriptionEs: La credencial del INE (Instituto Nacional Electoral) es la identificacion mas aceptada en Mexico. Aqui te explicamos como obtener la tuya.

steps.title: Find Your Nearest INE Module
steps.titleEs: Encuentra Tu Modulo INE Mas Cercano
steps.description: Use the INE website to locate the nearest registration module. You can also call 800-433-2000 for information.
steps.descriptionEs: Usa el sitio web del INE para localizar el modulo de registro mas cercano. Tambien puedes llamar al 800-433-2000 para informacion.

steps.title: Gather Documents
steps.description: You need proof of identity, proof of address, and proof of Mexican citizenship.
steps.descriptionEs: Necesitas comprobante de identidad, comprobante de domicilio y comprobante de nacionalidad mexicana.
documents: Birth certificate or certificate of Mexican nationality
Proof of address (utility bill, bank statement, not older than 3 months)
steps.tips: If you recently moved, make sure your proof of address matches your current residence.

steps.title: Visit the Module
steps.description: Visit the INE module with your documents. You'll be photographed, fingerprinted, and your signature will be captured digitally. No appointment needed but arrive early.
steps.descriptionEs: Visita el modulo del INE con tus documentos. Te tomaran foto, huellas digitales y tu firma sera capturada digitalmente. No se necesita cita pero llega temprano.

steps.title: Pick Up Your Credential
steps.description: Your INE card will be ready in approximately 2-4 weeks. Return to the same module with your receipt to pick it up.
steps.descriptionEs: Tu credencial INE estara lista en aproximadamente 2-4 semanas. Regresa al mismo modulo con tu recibo para recogerla.

title: How to Get or Print Your CURP
titleEs: Como Obtener o Imprimir Tu CURP
description: The CURP (Clave Unica de Registro de Poblacion) is your unique population registry key. You can look it up and print it for free online.
descriptionEs: La CURP (Clave Unica de Registro de Poblacion) es tu clave unica de registro de poblacion. Puedes consultarla e imprimirla gratis en linea.

steps.title: Visit the CURP Website
steps.titleEs: Visitar el Sitio Web de CURP
steps.description: Go to the official RENAPO website to look up your CURP. You can search by name or by your CURP number if you already have it.
steps.descriptionEs: Ve al sitio web oficial de RENAPO para consultar tu CURP. Puedes buscar por nombre o por tu numero de CURP si ya lo tienes.

steps.title: Enter Your Information
steps.description: Enter your full name, date of birth, state of birth, and sex. The system will find your CURP.
steps.descriptionEs: Ingresa tu nombre completo, fecha de nacimiento, estado de nacimiento y sexo. El sistema encontrara tu CURP.
steps.tips: Use the exact name as it appears on your birth certificate, including accents.

steps.title: Download and Print
steps.description: Once found, you can download your CURP as a PDF and print it. This printout is officially valid for most tramites.
steps.descriptionEs: Una vez encontrada, puedes descargar tu CURP como PDF e imprimirla. Esta impresion es oficialmente valida para la mayoria de los tramites.
steps.tips: If your CURP is not found, you may need to register at your local Registro Civil office.

title: How to Get Temporary Residency in Mexico
titleEs: Como Obtener la Residencia Temporal en Mexico
description: Guide for foreigners who want to live in Mexico for more than 180 days. Covers the temporary resident visa and card process.
descriptionEs: Guia para extranjeros que quieren vivir en Mexico por mas de 180 dias. Cubre el proceso de visa y tarjeta de residente temporal.

steps.title: Apply at a Mexican Consulate
steps.description: Visit your nearest Mexican consulate in your home country to apply for a temporary resident visa. You'll need to demonstrate economic solvency.
steps.descriptionEs: Visita el consulado mexicano mas cercano en tu pais de origen para solicitar una visa de residente temporal. Necesitaras demostrar solvencia economica.
documents: Proof of economic solvency (bank statements showing ~$2,500 USD/month for 12 months, or ~$42,000 USD in investments)
steps.tips: Economic solvency requirements change annually. Check the consulate website for current amounts.

steps.title: Enter Mexico with Your Visa
steps.titleEs: Entrar a Mexico con Tu Visa
steps.description: Once approved, you'll receive a visa sticker in your passport. Enter Mexico and tell immigration you're coming as a temporary resident.
steps.descriptionEs: Una vez aprobada, recibiras una etiqueta de visa en tu pasaporte. Entra a Mexico e informa a inmigracion que vienes como residente temporal.
steps.tips: You have 180 days from visa issuance to enter Mexico.

steps.title: Complete INM Registration
steps.description: Within 30 days of arrival, visit your local INM (Instituto Nacional de Migracion) office to exchange your visa for a resident card.
steps.descriptionEs: Dentro de 30 dias de tu llegada, visita tu oficina local del INM (Instituto Nacional de Migracion) para cambiar tu visa por una tarjeta de residente.
documents: Payment receipt for resident card fee
steps.tips: The 30-day window is strict. Don't miss it or you may need to restart the process.

steps.title: Receive Your Resident Card
steps.description: Your temporary resident card will be ready in approximately 2-4 weeks. This card is valid for 1-4 years and is renewable.
steps.descriptionEs: Tu tarjeta de residente temporal estara lista en aproximadamente 2-4 semanas. Esta tarjeta es valida por 1-4 anos y es renovable.
steps.tips: With temporary residency you can get an RFC, open bank accounts, and work (with a separate work permit).

title: How to Register for Your RFC (Tax ID)
description: The RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes) is your Mexican tax identification number. Required for employment, banking, and many tramites.
descriptionEs: El RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes) es tu numero de identificacion fiscal mexicano. Requerido para empleo, banca y muchos tramites.

steps.title: Pre-register Online
steps.description: Visit the SAT (Servicio de Administracion Tributaria) website to begin your pre-registration. This generates an appointment.
steps.descriptionEs: Visita el sitio web del SAT (Servicio de Administracion Tributaria) para comenzar tu pre-registro. Esto genera una cita.

steps.title: Attend SAT Office
steps.description: Visit the SAT office on your scheduled appointment date with all required documents.
steps.descriptionEs: Visita la oficina del SAT en la fecha de tu cita programada con todos los documentos requeridos.
documents: Proof of address (not older than 3 months)
USB drive (for your e.firma digital signature)
steps.tips: Bring a USB drive! They'll create your e.firma (digital signature) which you'll need for online tax filings.

steps.title: Receive Your RFC and e.firma
steps.description: You'll receive your RFC number and e.firma digital certificate on the same visit. Keep your e.firma password safe - you'll need it for all SAT operations.
steps.descriptionEs: Recibiras tu numero de RFC y certificado digital e.firma en la misma visita. Guarda tu contrasena de e.firma segura - la necesitaras para todas las operaciones del SAT.
